translated_title: Sheinbaum Supervises Construction of the Mexico City-Querétaro Passenger Train; "It's Progressing According to Schedule"
original_title: Sheinbaum supervisa construcción del tren de pasajeros CDMX-Querétaro; "Va avanzando conforme al programa"
author: Arturo Sánchez Jiménez
meta_description: Some 18,500 people are working on the 230-kilometer double-track line, which will link Buenavista to downtown Querétaro in about two hours at up to 180 km/h.
